tagline: It was never just a game.
secondaryTagline: Some things are worth keeping private.
positioning: A private communication and curated memory platform hidden behind a classic 2048 game decoy.

keyFeatures.name: Stealth Decoy Launcher
keyFeatures.desc: Fully functional 2048 classic game hiding private portal behind hidden gesture & 4-digit PIN.

keyFeatures.name: Zero-Knowledge Messaging
keyFeatures.desc: Private end-to-end chat with live presence, typing indicators, and instant read receipts.

keyFeatures.name: 2X Audio Player
keyFeatures.desc: Dynamic audio wave visualization with instant 1X/1.5X/2X speed switching.

keyFeatures.name: Floating Emoji Reactions
keyFeatures.desc: Haptic-driven floating emoji burst interactions on message bubbles.

keyFeatures.name: Ephemeral View Once Media
keyFeatures.desc: Self-destructing photo/video viewer with 3-second countdown and zero local trace.

keyFeatures.name: The Shared Vault
keyFeatures.desc: Magazine-style curated shared memory album with dual-user starring and tags.

keyFeatures.name: Half-Page Media Inspector
keyFeatures.desc: Fluid 50% to 100% sliding drawer displaying metadata, dates, and jump-to-chat links.

keyFeatures.name: Hardware DRM FLAG_SECURE
keyFeatures.desc: Android WindowManager security enforcement blocking all OS screenshots and screen recorders.

keyFeatures.name: 1-Tap Panic Escape
keyFeatures.desc: Instant hardware/gesture emergency escape immediately resetting app to innocent 2048 board.

keyFeatures.name: Biometric & Passkey Lock
keyFeatures.desc: Native fingerprint and device passkey biometric authentication.
